resources.string: Choose what to add to your library.

Aro will read the music indexed on this phone and add its details to your library. Your audio files stay on your phone. Existing songs, playlists, favorites, and edits are kept. Nothing is imported automatically; choose Import again to add new files. Folder exclusions and the minimum song duration still apply.

Check audio permission and that your music is available on this phone, then try again. Your existing library was kept.
